title: The Berkay Inan
description: Adds a mysterious and creepy entity named 'Berkay Inan' to your world, stalking you from the shadows.
body:
The Berkay Inan Mod                         those who contributed:Benalishero,VaylEnyx
                                            Main Owner:VaylEnyx

Thanks Benalishero for some supports for the mod 

This mod introduces a terrifying new entity to your Minecraft experience. Berkay Inan is not your average mob; he is a stalker who watches you from a distance, disappearing when you get too close.

Features:

Stalking AI: He finds you in the dark and watches your every move.

Creepy Atmosphere: Adds a layer of psychological horror to your survival world.

Beta Phase: The mod is currently in active development.
